name: Cá song
summary: Cá song is one of the foods the 28 July 2025 special-zone list tells a visitor to eat. The 20 June 2013 board sells it by the kilogram, sometimes split above and below 2 kg, and also prints cá song vang, cá song hoa, and cá song vang lai hổ as their own lines. It does not say those lines are the same fish. One line prints “Cá song, Cá húi” together. The 8 January 2016 article says the island’s seafood is best in winter, before the spring spawn.
howToEat: Order it by weight and have the kitchen cook it. The cooking method is not given. A current price is Check on arrival.
where: Đường 1/4 and đường Núi Ngọc, the streets on the 20 June 2013 board. A current door is Check on arrival. The 20 June 2013 board is a price list. A current price is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Cá song on Cat Ba — by the kilogram
seoDescription: Cá song is on the Cat Ba special-zone eat list and on the 20 June 2013 board by the kilogram. A current price is Check on arrival.
